title: tdh.synth.beep.ui~
description: `tdh.synth.beep.ui~` is a small, intentionally limited beep synthesizer intended for testing, sequencing, and learning basic synthesis. A bang triggers a tone whose frequency or MIDI pitch, duration, attack/decay time, and waveshape can be controlled; it outputs both the beep signal and its envelope signal, which can control another part of a patch.
